title: Relay portrait round 06 shape hierarchy lesson
summary: In a native 144x144 Relay portrait experiment, rebuilding the asymmetric torn hood, tilted CRT face, separated broken halo and scarf as large silhouette clusters before damage/detail improved reference identity compared with a prior symmetrical frontal round. Integer-pixel Pillow edits used 25 colors and binary alpha; validation confirms file structure, NOT artistic quality. Remaining weaknesses: overly rounded CRT, weak shoulder planes, thin overgrowth, and display-only glitches. Next practice: sharper 3/4 faceted CRT, stronger shoulder anatomy, organic seam growth, and true-motion studies.
